title: SEGMENT-VECTOR-JUMP-CAP3443: coarse precision jumps and full-vector data improve time and copies

claims.statement: For EVERY N>=2 and secret s, n=ceil(log2N), the SINGLE SEGMENT-VECTOR-JUMP-CAP3443 algorithm exactly specified in proof.md/nonpower_merge.md/qudit_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Actual segmented128-cycle kernel/Cleaf4194304 cap is retained; coarse jumps g=hstar-6 with hstar=floor((base-Dwidth)/16)-1024u yield a fixed Nsmax number of physical CRT/Dirichlet-scored coarse batches. Actual full2^rout fine vectors withrout=b+ceilLog2(n^5), realCf=2^161dl2^m raw guards, globalA=4Lblk attempts and explicitly compiled finite every-secret PGM recover signed odd/twoadic blocks. No source purification/QRAM/free arbitrary rotation is used. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch including failed/reset/projection/rejected/discarded/partial sources, wrong labels/prefixes, finite branch, actual table initialization, bit/gate/address/circuit synthesis/measurement/reset costs. Exact q=141421/100000,t=39999899241/28284200000 and negative3443n^1/4 classical term are retained. Finite n<2^128 exhaustive correctness and uniform absolute resource constants are separately proved. ConstantsCleaf/Nsmax are enormous; no practical speed, optimum or priority claim. Total charged work isO(n^(5/2)2^(t sqrt n)), exactindex1/2.
